title: Business, Base, Settlement, Faction, Crew, Family & SCL Integration
objective: Deliver one bounded read-only integration projection connecting completed ODL organization-life projections to explicit visible canonical business, base, settlement, faction, crew and family owner references, plus an identity-preserving SCL-facing reference handoff, without creating new owner truth, aggregate-unit state, command mechanics, owner mutation, permission authority or SCL implementation.

resolved_contract.owner_rule: Every accepted integration observation is an explicit visible owner-backed link carrying organization/subject identity, integration kind, canonical integration reference, owner authority/reference, profile/context, provenance and visibility references. ODL-07 records no business, base, settlement, faction, crew or family truth of its own and does not infer links from labels, membership counts, titles, pressure states, resource states, political states or events.
resolved_contract.owner_mapping_rule: Observed links are compatible only when their owner authority is allowed for that integration kind. DPL/MIB-13 remain business/economy reference owners; MIB-14 remains base and crew/station foundation owner; MIB-11/WCI retain World/settlement context; MIB-09 retains faction/relationship/reputation authority; Character-Actors retains person/crew/family identity and agency; Social-Relations retains family/household relationship truth. APW-D26 remains Project/time context authority and Permission/visibility remains authorization authority.
resolved_contract.resolution_rule: Visibility filtering occurs first. Observations are reconciled by canonical integration reference. A link resolves only when compatible visible observed evidence agrees on integration kind, owner authority/reference and profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown evidence remains unknown; incompatible-only remains incompatible; divergent visible kind/owner/profile/context tuples or mixed observed/incompatible evidence remains conflict. Canonical-owner contradictions are never auto-resolved.
resolved_contract.advisory_rule: Visible ODL-01..06 outputs may be surfaced only as separately labeled advisory context. Taxonomy, load, politics, role/succession, resource/admin and crisis/recovery projections never synthesize an ODL-07 owner link, alter a link state, create a member/asset relation or trigger an owner-domain outcome.
resolved_contract.scl_handoff_rule: The SCL-facing surface is an identity-preserving read-only reference handoff over already-visible ODL-07 links and advisory ODL references. It defines no SCL scale taxonomy, unit/formation/squad/fleet/army identity, constituent aggregation, membership mutation, readiness, command hierarchy, order, phase, combat resolution, casualty/damage reconciliation or strategic consequence. SCL-01+ remains the future authority for those mechanics.
resolved_contract.project_time_rule: Visible APW-D26 Project/time references may be carried as context only; wall-clock time, Project schedules and ODL state never advance campaign time or mutate Projects.
resolved_contract.permission_rule: Business ownership, base control, settlement status, faction membership, crew station, family role, organizational title, ODL state or SCL-facing inclusion never grants system permission, action authority or autonomous command authority.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized business, base, settlement, faction, crew, family, relationship, leadership, resource, Project, ODL advisory, profile/context, provenance and permission evidence is filtered before links, states, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts, SCL-facing handoff or AI context; hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.mutation_rule: No business/economy, base/vehicle, settlement/World, faction/relationship/reputation, Character/crew/family, leadership, resource, Project/time, owner or permission mutation is performed. No SCL command/action/resolution/consequence mechanics execute and no canonical write occurs.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-07 persistence or duplicate business/base/settlement/faction/crew/family/SCL/relationship/permission ledger; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.validation: Acceptance first; genuine self-hosted RED while the production contract/panel are absent; exactly one ODL-07 current-family Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout; final exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparison.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-01..06 remain completed_verified and are not reopened.
MIB-09, MIB-11, MIB-13, MIB-14, Character-Actors, Social-Relations, APW-D26, DPL, WCI and Permission/visibility canonical ownership remains unchanged.
No owner mutation, aggregate/unit state, SCL mechanics, command/action/system permission, campaign-time advancement, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
ODL-08+, SCL-01+ implementation, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

Authorized only one application branch and the acceptance-first ODL-07 validation workflow; SCL mechanics and owner mutations remain closed.
